_comment: Canonical logical objects the Patient Experience Command Center accelerator reasons over. Accelerator-owned and target-agnostic. The customer maps each of their physical tables onto one of these via ACCELERATOR_CORE_ELEMENTS.LOGICAL_OBJECT. Templates gate on presence: a REQUIRED object missing fails the readiness gate; an OPTIONAL object missing causes the dependent arm/panel to be dropped (graceful degradation).

objects.label: HCAHPS survey response
objects.powers: spine (DENORM_SURVEY_RESPONSE_DETAIL), all top-box, composite, star, communication, responsiveness, discharge, would-recommend, equity, points-lost
objects.notes: The minimum viable source. Response-level HCAHPS item ordinals -> top-box via the crosswalk.

objects.label: HCAHPS measure catalog
objects.powers: measure->domain mapping, CMS weight (composite/star), top-box definition
objects.notes: Reference. Drives which item is which and how it weights into the composite.

objects.label: HCAHPS national benchmark
objects.notes: Reference. National average + top-quartile top-box per measure.

objects.label: Top-box performance target
objects.powers: target ticks on bullet charts, gap-to-target
objects.notes: Reference. Org/unit top-box targets by fiscal year.

objects.label: HCAHPS star cut-points
objects.notes: Reference. Top-box bands per star level (SUMMARY row = composite).

objects.label: Facility unit dimension
objects.powers: unit name/type/service line for by-unit composite, rounding targeting
objects.notes: Reference dimension.

objects.label: Encounter-to-unit map
objects.powers: attaches encounters (and journey/ops rows) to a unit
objects.notes: Reference bridge between encounters and units.

objects.label: Analysis period anchor
objects.notes: A single anchor month. History horizon is a config value; if the customer has no clock, default to max(discharge_date).

objects.label: Free-text survey comment
objects.notes: UNSTRUCTURED text. Absent => voice panel + citations degrade to structured only.

objects.label: Contact-center call + recording
objects.notes: STRUCTURED detail + UNSTRUCTURED recording stage. Absent => transcripts omitted.

objects.label: Grievance / complaint case
objects.powers: service-recovery (grievance aging vs regulatory window, SLA adherence), awaiting-recovery KPI
objects.notes: Absent => Follow-up & Loyalty recovery panels omitted.

objects.label: Encounter care team
objects.powers: med-rec completion, interpreter use, discharge readiness
objects.notes: Absent => med-rec / interpreter signals omitted.

objects.label: Post-discharge callback
objects.powers: closing-the-loop funnel (reached / issue / resolved), follow-up voice signal
objects.notes: Absent => discharge close-the-loop panel degrades.

objects.label: Visit timing event
objects.powers: wait-by-area, LWBS, access experience, registration time
objects.notes: Ambulatory/imaging/lab timing. Absent => wait panel degrades to ED only.

objects.label: ED encounter event
objects.notes: Absent => ED wait/LWBS omitted from access.

objects.label: Call-light daily rollup
objects.notes: Absent => call-light driver omitted.

objects.label: Telemetry alarm event
objects.notes: Absent => alarm-fatigue signal omitted.

objects.label: Unit staffing daily
objects.notes: Absent => staffing driver omitted.

objects.label: Facilities work order
objects.notes: Absent => wayfinding op-signal omitted.

objects.label: Appointment
objects.notes: Absent => follow-up-scheduled rate omitted.

objects.label: Patient portal message
objects.notes: Absent => portal voice omitted.

objects.label: Online review
objects.notes: Absent => review voice omitted.

objects.label: Patient demographics + consent
objects.notes: Absent => equity lens + consent-aware channel omitted.

objects.label: VBP program config
objects.grain: program x fiscal year x domain
objects.powers: VBP payment-at-risk KPI (with OPS_TARGET payment base)
objects.notes: Absent => VBP $-at-risk KPI omitted.

objects.label: Operational target reference
objects.powers: wait-by-area targets, service-recovery SLA targets, VBP payment base
objects.notes: Small reference of operational targets + the net-inpatient-revenue base for VBP $.

objects.label: Clinical observation / flowsheet
objects.notes: Derived signal from flowsheet observations. Absent => pain-reassessment signal omitted.
